title: The Shrimp That Boils Water
hook: A two-inch shrimp can punch water hard enough to spark actual light.
script: A two-inch shrimp can punch water hard enough to spark actual light. How does a tiny claw create temperatures nearly as hot as the Sun? The pistol shrimp locks its claw like a spring, loading muscle power into a biological catapult. When it snaps, a high-speed water jet rips open an empty cavitation bubble. Then the bubble collapses. The imploding void reaches over 4,700 degrees, flashing with light before the heat can spread. That shockwave stuns prey instantly and can even blind military submarine sonar. All sparked by a strike faster than a bullet underwater.
